preparation_cost_scope: One-attempt contended process observations, not clean compilation benchmarks. SFIR build includes frontend plus mandatory Binaryen; native-build takes raw input and repeats optimization before LLVM/link. Adding those two clocks repeats optimization. Clean native entry is separate. Rust per-bin Cargo builds share target caches and are not independent builds from empty caches.
verification_scope: All archived bytes, source/data hashes, trial streams, saved output checks and native optimized-guest pairs checked. All medians/ranges/ratios independently recomputed from raw stdout and compared with existing helpers. No workloads, tests or full toolchain/large artifact verification rerun.
aggregate_scope: Equal weight per matching case for each separate numerator/denominator pair; geometric mean exp(mean(log(SFIR/control))). Excludes all unavailable, failed or incomplete primary routes. No corrected Mperm substitution or mixing of historical/paired-buffer results. Below one favors SFIR. Ratios describe different source representations/GC/numeric/opacity choices, not compiler quality alone.

comparability_notes.text: Original controls retain Scheme representations and call/cc; adapted controls expose port representation choices. They are separate comparisons with explicit matching counts.

Vector/list/Rc/owned-reclamation, numeric-domain and black_box choices differ from SFIR managed representations/checked arithmetic and original Scheme numeric behavior. Ratios do not isolate optimizer or collector quality.
Rust applies black_box(x + 1) on each Peano increment; SFIR retains ordinary succ/pred recurrence. Extra Rust opacity restricts optimization freedom.
Array1 and Equal each use one outer invocation with complete canonical inner parameters, rather than repeating their whole workload canonical_count times.
These interpreters are ordinary compiled benchmark code, not a product Scheme frontend.
Library/service and owned-file packet-input changes are separate. Landed 20261015-input-packets.md supplies its own Cat/WC paired results; none is substituted here.
